description: This file defines the API for accessing and manipulating native window objects in Android, including enums for formats and transforms, function declarations for window operations, and data structures related to native window buffers.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_acquire
methods.description: Increases the reference count of the native window to prevent deletion.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_release
methods.description: Decreases the reference count of the native window, allowing deletion if count reaches zero.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_getWidth
methods.description: Returns the current width in pixels of the window surface.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_getHeight
methods.description: Returns the current height in pixels of the window surface.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_getFormat
methods.description: Returns the current pixel format of the window surface.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_setBuffersGeometry
methods.description: Changes the format and size of the window buffers.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_lock
methods.description: Locks the window's surface for drawing.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_unlockAndPost
methods.description: Unlocks the surface and posts the buffer to display.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_setBuffersTransform
methods.description: Sets a transform to be applied to buffers.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_setBuffersDataSpace
methods.description: Sets the data space of the buffers.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_getBuffersDataSpace
methods.description: Gets the data space of the buffers.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_getBuffersDefaultDataSpace
methods.description: Gets the default data space of the buffers.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_setFrameRate
methods.description: Sets the intended frame rate for the window.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_setFrameRateWithChangeStrategy
methods.description: Sets the frame rate with a change strategy.

methods.name: ANativeWindow_clearFrameRate
methods.description: Clears the set frame rate for the window.
